title: Optimal Product Decomposition
description:
Given a positive integer n, your goal is to partition it into the sum of k positive integers (where k >= 2) such that the product of these integers is maximized. Return the maximum possible product.

Example 1
Input: n = 2
Output: 1

Example 2
Input: n = 10
Output: 36
input_format: The first line contains a single integer n.
output_format: Print the maximum achievable product using at least two positive integers.
